unlocked.title: Third Floor Confidential
unlocked.reveal: Priya Raman ran @lowell.three. In July, when Housing sent the floor list, she Googled the name on the single across the hall, found a building and a father, and decided Cal would be the best character of her year. She knew his name before he said it and filmed everything vertically, for her archive. She shot the toast from beside the keg table, posted the motel line she had heard him read aloud, photographed him leaving at 1:10 a.m. from her doorway, trimmed a clip so Dev's face took a punch meant for the Rho, and stood in the middle of the Quad at 3 a.m. to shoot his lit window, tracking the grass home on her slippers. The account fed a solo show, THE BOY ACROSS THE HALL, pitched with permission she never asked for. In her drafts sat one post never sent: their move-in selfie, captioned 'the legacy is my best friend.' That part was always true.
clues: S1E1: Priya burst in with 'Hi, Cal, hide me' before he had told her his name.
S1E1: She filmed his room, and the Whitaker chant, vertically: 'For my archive.'
S1E2: The account's toast video was vertical, shot low and left of the keg table, where Priya screamed loudest.
S1E2: The account posted the motel line only Priya had heard him read aloud: 'who'd you call, babe?'
S1E2: Priya stayed in the hallway in her socks as he left at 1:10 a.m.; at 3:07 the account posted him on the stairs, shot low from a doorway.
S1E3: At the floor printer, a title page lay face-up: THE BOY ACROSS THE HALL (working title), a solo piece by Priya Raman.
S1E3: Mae said the pitch to the theater board read 'based on a true story, with permission.'
S1E3: The account posted the Brooks clip with Dev's face, cut one beat before Cal's comeback; Priya, loudly: 'Who would DO that? To DEV?'
S1E3: Yusuf traced the posts to one device on the Lowell third-floor wifi, active between 1 and 4 a.m.
S1E3: At 3:07 a.m. the account posted his lit window from the middle of the Quad; then Priya texted 'ur light's on.'
S1E4: Wet slipper prints with fresh-cut Quad grass ran from the stairwell to Priya's door at 3:14 a.m.
S1E4: Under a Post-it on Yusuf's laptop: priyas-iphone.
S1E4: Her phone's drafts held every post, a scheduled one of him in his father's blazer, and one never sent: their move-in selfie, 'the legacy is my best friend.'
